**Finding: compliant** (preferred position) — no redline proposed.

- **§ 2(a) Grant (p0022/p0024):** licence is expressly *non-exclusive*, and affirmatively confirms Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," subject only to TrueLink's IP and our § 10 confidentiality obligations. This exceeds the playbook's preferred position.
- **§ 8(d) (p0054) / Non-Competition Agreement:** the only "non-competition" hook restricts *TrueLink's* use of Credit Data — exclusivity running in our favour, so not a deviation per the detection guidance.
- **§ 3(i) (p0042):** "Client shall order TrueLink a credit report on each borrower for which an underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface" is the closest thing to a requirements commitment, but it bites only on borrowers we choose to underwrite through TrueLink's Interface — which § 2(a) says we need never use. Our freedom to source credit data and similar services elsewhere is intact, so this is noted rather than flagged.
- **§§ 5, 6, 7, 10, 12:** no "sole/exclusive provider," "all of its requirements," or third-party procurement bar. Minimum monthly fees in § 5(a) are a spend commitment, not exclusivity, and belong to a separate rule.
